shortForecast: Chance Rain Showers then Patchy Fog
name: Tonight
detailedForecast: A chance of rain showers and patchy fog before 11pm, then patchy fog and a slight chance of rain showers between 11pm and 1am. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 59. East wind around 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.
